entries.title: Deutsches Wörterbuch von Jacob Grimm und Wilhelm Grimm, Erstausgabe (1DWB), via Wörterbuchnetz

institutions: Niedersächsische Akademie der Wissenschaften zu Göttingen

dating.edition_or_version: Wörterbuchnetz web surface reports version 01/25; exact article revision must be captured per consultation

entries.scholarly_posture: institutionally maintained historical German dictionary and a starting witness for period-sensitive senses, never a sufficient Nietzsche-specific interpretation
limits: dictionary article date and cited source range must be recorded per word
the digital presentation license was not established from the landing page
a dictionary sense does not establish Nietzsche's intended sense

citation_requirements: cite dictionary title, article headword, Wörterbuchnetz URL, displayed version, and access date

blocking_reasons: exact article and source citations are not yet selected
resource-specific reuse terms require human review

entries.notes: Prefer article-level citation and preserve disagreement with modern and Nietzsche-specific resources.

entries.title: DWDS-Wörterbuch

institutions: Berlin-Brandenburgische Akademie der Wissenschaften, Zentrum Sprache

dating.edition_or_version: continuously expanded; exact article revision must be frozen at consultation time

entries.scholarly_posture: continuously maintained modern German meaning dictionary used as a control against anachronistic or obsolete readings
limits: modern definitions cannot substitute for late-nineteenth-century evidence
the exact online dictionary dataset license was not confirmed from the general repository policy
article revision must be snapshotted per use

citation_requirements: cite the DWDS article URL, article revision or access date, and owning BBAW project

blocking_reasons: article-level selection has not begun
modern meaning must be triangulated with historical witnesses

entries.notes: Use as a modern control, not as the historical authority for Nietzsche's German.

entries.title: Etymologisches Wörterbuch des Deutschen (EtymWB), Wolfgang Pfeifer project

institutions: Berlin-Brandenburgische Akademie der Wissenschaften, Zentrum Sprache

dating.edition_or_version: over 22000 headwords and continuously supplemented and revised; exact article revision must be frozen

entries.scholarly_posture: institutionally maintained etymological reference candidate; every etymological statement still needs exact article citation and competing-source review
limits: etymological reconstruction is not semantic intention
model paraphrase of an entry is not evidence
the exact resource license and article revision remain item-level questions

citation_requirements: cite EtymWB, the exact headword URL, revision or access date, and the BBAW owner

blocking_reasons: no headword packet has been selected
a second etymological source is required for contested claims

entries.notes: An accepted ToS etymology may cite this resource but can never be created from model memory alone.

entries.title: Deutsches Textarchiv (DTA)

institutions: Berlin-Brandenburgische Akademie der Wissenschaften, Zentrum Sprache

dating.edition_or_version: DTA corpus plus the 1883 Schmeitzner first edition of part 1, DTA ID 16840, current generated DTABf/TEI P5 object

entries.scholarly_posture: historical New High German reference corpus plus an exact, source-structured 1883 Zarathustra part-1 witness; DTA reports OCR followed by native-speaker checking under its transcription guidelines, which is external quality evidence rather than ToS acceptance
limits: corpus frequency does not establish Nietzsche's sense
every selected document retains its own source and license
DTABf documentation license does not automatically license corpus texts or images
the DTA reading is not a critical-edition reading and has not been accepted by ToS
facsimile-image rights remain separate from the annotated text
current DTA terms and TEI header report CC BY-SA 4.0 while the live Dublin Core field still reports the former CC BY-NC 3.0

citation_requirements: cite DTA, the exact document identifier and source edition, access date, and document-specific license

blocking_reasons: no period-matched comparison corpus slice has been frozen
the exact annotated-text license evidence is internally conflicting
no exact comparison to a critical-edition passage has been completed
no German-competent ToS reviewer has accepted the reading

entries.notes: The exact TEI is checksum-bound in local gitignored custody. Use it as an independently sourced structured witness with page-return anchors; do not treat institutional checking, open-license evidence, or schema validity as ToS textual acceptance.

entries.title: Digitale Kritische Gesamtausgabe Werke und Briefe (eKGWB)

dating.original_or_coverage_date: digital form of KGW 1967- and KGB 1975-
dating.edition_or_version: digital critical edition with approximately 6600 incorporated philological corrections, stable sigla URLs, and XML-TEI encoding

entries.scholarly_posture: digital form of the Colli-Montinari German reference edition, suitable for exact citation, recurrence search, and critical comparison but not a replacement for the acquired scan witness
limits: CC BY-NC-ND forbids derivative publication and commercial reuse without permission
search hits remain observations until source context is reviewed
ToS must cite the exact stable passage URL and keep its own source witness distinct

citation_requirements: attribute Nietzsche Source and the editors, cite the exact stable eKGWB URL, and preserve the CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 notice

blocking_reasons: Za-I-Vorrede-1 is frozen only as a metadata locator; exact passage alignment and human bibliographic/rights review remain pending
no-derivatives boundary excludes treating the edition as a freely transformable ToS corpus

entries.notes: Primary candidate for critical cross-check and Nietzsche-wide recurrence lookup. One metadata-only Za-I-Vorrede-1 route is frozen without text capture or admission.

entries.title: Sämtliche Werke. Kritische Studienausgabe (KSA), Band 4: Also sprach Zarathustra I-IV

dating.edition_or_version: Band 4 print/digital publisher record for Zarathustra I-IV; exact accessed manifestation not acquired

entries.scholarly_posture: standard critical study edition candidate for print-page citation and apparatus comparison, subordinate to exact manifestation and access proof
limits: publisher metadata is not access to the full critical text or apparatus
page references depend on the exact edition and manifestation
no content has been acquired for this laboratory

citation_requirements: cite KSA volume, editors, edition, page or section, publisher, and DOI where applicable

blocking_reasons: exact manifestation and access path are not registered
content and reuse rights are not granted

entries.notes: Retain as the conventional print citation route even when eKGWB supplies the digital critical comparison.

entries.title: Nietzsche-Wörterbuch

dating.edition_or_version: four-volume project; approximately 300 Nietzsche terms planned, with new articles pre-published in Nietzsche Online

entries.scholarly_posture: Nietzsche-specific lexical research resource reporting occurrence counts, uses, senses, contexts, linguistic and philosophical history, scholarship, and reception
limits: coverage is selective rather than a complete word index
dictionary interpretation remains a scholarly witness rather than semantic truth
full content access and reuse terms are not established

citation_requirements: cite exact dictionary article, editors, volume or Nietzsche Online version, page or DOI, and access date

blocking_reasons: relevant articles and coverage have not been identified
access and reuse permission are unresolved

entries.notes: Highest-priority specialized lexical witness after exact German source acceptance; preserve counter-readings and article scope.

entries.title: Nietzsche-Index zu den Werken in drei Bänden

dating.edition_or_version: 517-page index bound to the Werke in drei Bänden; DDB metadata last updated 2026-02-17 and exposes only the table of contents

entries.scholarly_posture: edition-bound printed word-index candidate useful for comparison, not a current critical-edition concordance
limits: index is bound to Schlechta's Werke in drei Bänden rather than KGW or KSA
only the table of contents is digitally available from the catalog surface
content license is attributed to Hanser and is not granted to ToS

citation_requirements: cite Karl Schlechta, exact index edition, DNB identifier, and the owning source edition

blocking_reasons: full index is not accessible from the discovered record
edition-specific bias must be measured against eKGWB and KSA
permission or lawful library access is required

entries.notes: Useful as an explicit Wortindex comparator only after its edition boundary is made visible.

entries.title: Nietzsche Online

dating.edition_or_version: publisher title list dated 2025-04-22 was the freshest enumerated content surface found; live entitlement and update state require recheck at access time

entries.scholarly_posture: integrated publisher research database combining corrected critical text, variants, commentary, Nietzsche-Wörterbuch links, concordances, and secondary literature
limits: concept documentation is not proof of current entitlement or exact live holdings
database content is subscription-controlled and in copyright
the 2025 title list must be refreshed before an experiment

citation_requirements: cite the exact Nietzsche Online object, DOI or passage, content version, and access date

blocking_reasons: no subscription or institutional entitlement is registered
no content-use permission exists
live holdings and revision date require refresh

entries.notes: Potentially the richest integrated route, but it enters only after lawful access, exact-version capture, and cost comparison against open eKGWB.

entries.title: Так говорил Заратустра, перевод Ю. М. Антоновского, научно отредактированная версия в полном собрании сочинений, том 4

dating.original_or_coverage_date: Antonovsky translation lineage begins in the late nineteenth century; exact lineage is not yet established
dating.edition_or_version: Moscow, 2007, 432 pages, ISBN 978-5-250-06018-9; the edition states that the Antonovsky translation was newly edited and checked

entries.scholarly_posture: established Russian translation-lineage candidate in a scientifically edited collected-works volume; authoritative witness for comparison, never absolute ground truth
limits: the 2007 edited text is not assumed equivalent to 1898, 1911, 1996, or other Antonovsky editions
recognized-comparator content remains sealed until independent lanes freeze
local payload rights are unreviewed and redistribution is not authorized

citation_requirements: cite translator, scientific editor, exact 2007 edition, volume, page, ISBN, and ToS item identity

blocking_reasons: real human source review has accepted 0 of 30 German units
recognized comparator is sealed
translation-lineage equivalence is unresolved
human rights review and permission route are absent

entries.notes: This is the current sealed comparator identity in the laboratory plan, not a pre-revealed answer key.

entries.title: Так говорил Заратустра: Книга для всех и ни для кого, перевод Ю. М. Антоновского, 4-е издание

dating.edition_or_version: fourth edition, Saint Petersburg, VIII + 292 pages; full-view and PDF links are exposed by NEB

entries.scholarly_posture: historical Antonovsky translation witness candidate suitable for lineage comparison with the edited 2007 expression
limits: free viewer or download availability is not by itself a completed rights assessment
the fourth edition must not be treated as textually identical to the 2007 scientific redaction
the item has not been acquired or fixity-registered by ToS

citation_requirements: cite translator, fourth-edition statement, publisher, year, page, NEB record, and exact acquired-item digest if later admitted

blocking_reasons: rights statement and file-level terms require review before acquisition
translation-lineage relation to other Antonovsky editions is unreviewed
no fixity or source-item record exists in ToS

entries.notes: High-value historical comparator because it can expose editorial change hidden by a shared translator label.

entries.title: Фридрих Ницше. Сочинения в двух томах. Том 2. Москва: Мысль, 1996

dating.edition_or_version: volume 2 of a two-volume collected edition; work-specific Zarathustra translator attribution remains pending source-visible review

entries.scholarly_posture: additional Russian collected-edition witness candidate; bibliographic presence is supported, but the Zarathustra translator and textual equivalence are deliberately unresolved
limits: the volume lists multiple translators and does not yet prove the work-specific attribution
equivalence with the 2007 Antonovsky expression is not assumed
the local aggregate PDF is in copyright with no redistribution authorization

citation_requirements: cite exact volume, editor, publisher, year, page, work-specific translator once verified, and ToS item identity

blocking_reasons: work-specific translator attribution requires manual title-page and contents review
candidate equivalence with other Russian expressions is unresolved
rights review and content-use permission are absent

entries.notes: This entry exists to preserve uncertainty rather than to manufacture a second independent Russian translation.

entries.scholarly_posture: publisher-backed annotated English translation candidate emphasizing musicality and biblical and classical allusions
limits: English is an additional witness and not the default bridge into Russian
publisher description cannot substitute for passage-level comparison
full translation is in copyright and has not been acquired

citation_requirements: cite translator, title, Oxford World's Classics edition, ISBN, page, and publication year

blocking_reasons: exact edition has not been acquired
content-use and quotation scope require rights review
passage-level suitability has not been manually tested

full text access is entitlement-controlled and in copyright

citation_requirements: cite translator, editor, exact printing or digital manifestation, DOI or ISBN, year, and page

blocking_reasons: exact manifestation has not been acquired
access entitlement and permissible research use are unresolved
passage-level comparison has not begun

entries.notes: Use to test preservation of versification and poetic form after independent lanes, alongside rather than instead of Parkes.
